# Noor Maison by Saba

> Noor Maison by Saba is a jewellery shop in Noorkhan Bazar, Hyderabad, Telangana, India, selling Korean-imported, anti-tarnish jewellery and press-on nail sets online at https://noormaisonbysaba.com/.

## Facts
- Business name: Noor Maison by Saba
- Address: 22-1-809, Noorkhan Bazar, Hyderabad 500024, Telangana, India (landmark: opposite JJ Textile Lane)
- Phone: +91-8686690764 (86866 90764)
- Email: noormaisonbysaba@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/noormaison_by_saba
- All products are Korean imported. The jewellery is anti-tarnish.
- Free shipping on orders above ₹499. Free mirror on orders above ₹999. A surprise gift on orders above ₹1,499.
- How to order: choose a piece on the website, tap ORDER, fill in name, phone number and address. Payment is by UPI after Saba confirms the order. No account is needed.

## What she sells
- Necklace sets, earrings, pendants, bracelets (including Turkish bracelets and clover bracelets), rings
- Gold plated collection
- Press-on nail sets (10 sets)

## Key pages
- Home: https://noormaisonbysaba.com/
- Full catalogue: https://noormaisonbysaba.com/explore
- Press-on nails: https://noormaisonbysaba.com/nails
